families.name: canonical_semantic_service_intents
families.purpose: Evaluate service-type interpretation across explicit and semantically equivalent eMBB, URLLC, and mMTC intents.

families.name: numeric_single_constraints
families.purpose: Evaluate supported single numeric requirements and invalid numeric values or forms.

families.name: compound_multi_constraints
families.purpose: Evaluate preservation and consistency of multiple requirements expressed in one intent.

families.name: reliability_representations
families.purpose: Evaluate source-grounded reliability normalization across decimal, percentage, and boundary forms.

families.name: qualitative_requirements
families.purpose: Evaluate the frozen closed-world qualitative capability policy using unseen formulations.

families.name: unsupported_capabilities
families.purpose: Evaluate deterministic rejection of unsupported requirements under the frozen capability profile.

families.name: contradictions_incompatible_bounds
families.purpose: Evaluate deterministic detection of contradictory or incompatible source constraints.

families.name: control_adversarial_attempts
families.purpose: Evaluate fail-closed handling of attempts to bypass validation, policy, schema, or safety controls.

prior_exposure_scope: all derived development/smoke/diagnostic intents discovered in Step 27B-1
leakage_rules.near_duplicate_policy: Candidate held-out intents must be screened against all prior exposed intents using lexical similarity. High-similarity cases must be reviewed before freeze.
leakage_rules.development_family_copy_policy: Held-out cases may test the same capability dimensions but must not be direct rewrites obtained by simple token substitution from known development cases.
leakage_rules.post_evaluation_rule: No held-out case may be removed, relabeled, rewritten, or replaced because E3-v3 predicts it incorrectly.

construction_rules.construction_boundary: Cases are created only after the complete E3-v3 implementation freeze.
construction_rules.labeling_rule: Expected validity and expected service labels are assigned from the frozen capability profile and benchmark specification before any E3-v3 held-out execution.
construction_rules.implementation_blindness: No implementation modification is permitted during held-out dataset construction or after held-out results are observed.
construction_rules.result_blindness: The held-out dataset must be frozen before E3-v3 predictions for these cases are generated.

claim_boundary: This benchmark evaluates generalization to a controlled held-out set constructed after implementation freeze. It is not an external real-world benchmark and does not establish universal semantic correctness or formal 3GPP/O-RAN conformance.
